_doc: P4 engine switches. Defaults = DESIGN §8 'P4 rulings (2026-10-28)' and 'P4 rulings 2'. Every key is a switch (override with --set key=value); the engine itself has NO defaults (fifo.Policy raises PolicyRequired). Keys marked pending_architect are proposals awaiting confirmation.
pending_architect: fee_split: equal when any acquisition of the tx is pending
gas of a swap goes into the bought asset's basis (not off the sold asset's proceeds)
as_of_block: latest block with a stored P3 price; marks = latest stored price at or before it
